description: Election Commission - Mr. S. Somasuntharam of the Batticaloa Municipal Council has Vacated his Office of Member of that Municipal Council as he has Ceased to be a Member of the Tamil United Liberation Front
reasoning: This gazette notice is a declaration by a Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the vacation of office by a member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council. The content specifically deals with an electoral matter concerning a local government body, falling under the category of "Electoral processes and related matters" as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
